settings.label: At a glance
settings.text: Tastes like: bright fruit and a little zing. Fizz: crisp. Featuring: 9g plant fiber, 2g sugar and 35 calories per 12 fl oz can.

settings.label: What's inside
settings.text: Sparkling water, prebiotic plant fiber, fruit juice, botanical extracts, natural flavors and citric acid. No artificial sweeteners. Gluten-free and vegan. The full list is printed on every can.

settings.label: How to enjoy
settings.text: Chill, pop, pour over ice if you like. Drink it any time the 3pm snack slump hits. Start with one can a day if you are new to fiber.

settings.heading: Three things a good soda does

settings.title: Fiber that feeds
settings.text: 9g of plant fiber per can feeds your good bacteria, as part of a gut-friendly routine.

settings.title: Fizz that lasts
settings.text: Fine bubbles stay lively from first pop to last sip, so the can tastes as good as it looks.

settings.title: Flavor with staying power
settings.text: Real fruit juice and botanicals give a bright taste that lingers well past your first sip.

settings.image_alt: A hand holding a cold can of soda over a picnic blanket
settings.heading: Notes on getting the most from your can
settings.text: Chill it for at least two hours, pop the tab and pour over ice with a slice of citrus. Pair it with a snack at your usual slump hour, or swap it in for your afternoon soda. Keep a few in the fridge door and they will be gone by Friday.

settings.heading: What we put in, what we leave out

settings.title: Mostly plants
settings.text: Fiber, fruit juice and botanicals do the heavy lifting in every can.

settings.title: Nothing sketchy
settings.text: No artificial sweeteners, colors or preservatives make it past the door.

settings.title: Made for everyone
settings.text: Flavored, sized and fizzed for the way people really snack.

settings.label: What makes it different from regular soda?
settings.text: Fizz swaps most of the sugar for plant fiber and fruit-based sweetness, so you get the pop with 2g sugar and 35 calories.

settings.label: How many cans should I drink a day?
settings.text: Most people enjoy one a day. If you are new to fiber, start with one and see how you feel.

settings.label: Does it have caffeine?
settings.text: No. Fizz cans are caffeine-free, so they work at 3pm or 9pm.

settings.label: Is it vegan?
settings.text: Yes. Every flavor is vegan and gluten-free. Check the ingredient list on each page.

settings.label: How strong is the flavor?
settings.text: Bold enough to taste the fruit from the first sip, but never syrupy. It will not overpower your lunch.

settings.label: When will it arrive?
settings.text: Orders leave in one to two business days and take three to seven days to arrive within the United States.

settings.title: Tastes like summer in a can
settings.text: The cherry is bright without being sweet. A week in, there is always a can chilling in my fridge.
